name: Down and Out
body:
School divination; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round

DESCRIPTION

The magic of this spell allows you to see the best way to knock things down. You receive a +10 insight bonus to your next combat maneuver check to either disarm or trip an opponent.
